unlicensedInstallStatement: This installation is fully functional without a licence, permanently. The local runtime, direct machine-to-machine transport, and every safety control are free and are never licence-checked. Hosting the relay yourself is planned and not available yet; when it lands it will be free and never licence-checked too. A licence pays only for infrastructure we operate on your behalf.

hosted-relay.rationale: A relay server we operate, pay for, and keep online so two of your machines can reach each other across any network with no setup.
